text:
marta: Follow-up from PM-2026-30 (serving latency cascade). Dropping consolidated action list + owner proposals. Please ack or request handoff within 48h. Main asks: clear JIRA links, RACI per subtask, and verification format before PM close.

Actions proposed:
- JIRA-11011: per-model backpressure + short-term throttle (owner: alon)
- JIRA-11012: canary gating + automated rollback hook (owner: yuki, consult: eng-deploy)
- JIRA-11013: runbook rewrite + tabletop validation (owner: priya)
- JIRA-11014: KV eviction recurrence analysis (owner: alon)
- internal: add recurrence flag + weekly review card (owner: marta)

alon: I can take 11011 and 11014. Plan for 11011: quick throttle behind feature flag + metrics (p95/p99 by model). Quickstop PR in 2 business days, full remediation in 2 sprints. For 11014 I'll attach time series and heap dumps, aiming initial findings in 3 business days.

yuki: I'll own 11012. Proposed RACI: Yuki (R), eng-deploy (C), Marta (A), Alon (I). I'll open subtask for the canary harness and include rollback criteria.

priya: I'll take 11013. Will draft runbook PR with a tabletop script and add acceptance criteria. ETA: runbook draft in 4 days, tabletop next week.

devops-bot: Created subtask JIRA-11012.1 for canary harness: https://jira.redwood.local/browse/JIRA-11012.1

marta: Two process asks: 1) require a "remediation-verification" comment before PM close with exact format (see below), 2) if a remediation spans teams, create subtasks per team and RACI each one.

alon: Agreed on subtasks. For 11011 I'll include a short-term mitigation name "hotfix/11011-quickstop" and add a dashboard. @yuki please review the canary gating so we can coordinate rollout.

yuki: Will review. Canary default: 20m, fail if p99 > baseline*1.5 for 10m or error-rate > 0.5%. Will add those metrics to the subtask.

priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops-runbooks/pull/1244 - adds updated runbook template and a tabletop script. Includes a checklist item to add a verification comment before PM close.

release-bot: PM auto-tagged as "recurrence-candidate" (occurrences=3) and scheduled weekly recurrence review card: https://board.redwood.local/postmortems/recurrence

marta: Verification comment format (copy into the ticket when done):

remediation-verification: SHA=<git-sha> smoke=<smoke-id> traces=<link> notes=<short notes>

alon: I'll attach flamegraphs and a short repro script to 11014. If staging repro fails I'll request a 30m pairing with infra.

yuki: Opening subtask 11012.1 now and tagging eng-deploy. Will include partial rollout + rollback tests.

priya: For the tabletop, I'll include a simulated latency spike and a verification checklist for smoke runs. Inviting oncall and eng-platform.

marta: If you accept an owner here, please update the JIRA with RACI and an ETA. I'll close owner assignments in 48h unless someone requests a swap. Thanks. :white_check_mark:

alon: Acked. Updated JIRA-11011 and JIRA-11014 with RACI and ETAs.

yuki: Ack. Subtask created and eng-deploy tagged.

priya: Acked. PR created and tabletop scheduled.

marta: Closing owner assignment in 48h. If anyone needs to swap or split scope, call it out here and we'll coordinate subtasks.
